LESSON: LINES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: GEOMETRY Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experie
Topic 3.1: Lines
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Lines, part of GEOMETRY Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experie in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do you draw perpendicular lines?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Lines together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
